description: This file defines the ScanScreen widget for a Flutter application. It presents a mocked camera preview with overlay elements such as corner markers and a scan line, and includes controls for toggling flash, capturing an image, and opening a gallery. The widget handles user interactions, displays instructional text, and navigates to a steps screen with a stub payload upon capture.

classes.name: ScanScreen
classes.description: Main widget for the camera scanning interface, encapsulating UI components, state management, and interaction logic.

classes.name: _ScanScreenState
classes.description: State class managing animation controllers, UI interactions, and widget lifecycle for ScanScreen.

classes.name: _RoundIconButton
classes.description: A round icon button widget used for flash toggle and gallery access controls, with tooltip support.

classes.name: _ShutterButton
classes.description: A custom circular button widget that mimics a camera shutter for capturing images.

classes.name: _CornersOverlay
classes.description: A widget drawing corner overlays to indicate the scan area, with custom painter for corner lines.

classes.name: _CornerPainter
classes.description: CustomPainter that draws L-shaped corner lines to overlay on the scan area.

methods.name: _toggleFlash
methods.description: Toggles the flash state and shows a snackbar message.

methods.name: _openGallery
methods.description: Stub function to indicate upcoming gallery feature, shows informational snackbar.

methods.name: _capture
methods.description: Simulates capturing an image: shows 'Processing...' snackbar, delays briefly, then navigates to '/steps' with a sample payload.
